title: Roster startup restored
summary: The shared and saved roster now open reliably after the React interface migration.
changes: Roster startup no longer waits for a React-owned staffing field before the Changes component has mounted.
The same repair restores the read-only saved-roster path when the shared connection is unavailable.
A startup regression check now covers the delayed Changes component mount.
Roster calculations, staffing workflows, Supabase data, authentication, Chat and clinical decision rules remain unchanged.
